name: quilldown
description: Host-agnostic Markdown editors (wysiwyg + split) sharing one render pipeline.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @quilldown/core && npm run build -w @quilldown/wysiwyg && npm run build -w @quilldown/split && npm run build -w @quilldown/host-example
scripts.comment:ci: build 必须在 typecheck 前：跨包类型走的是各包 dist 的 d.ts（消费者视角），dist 不入库。
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
